title.narrative: Number of PPPs developed for the market through the use of the PPP PPF

comment.narrative: On-track. Refers to the number of PPPs developed for the market with support under the project (i.e., under the PPF). The intermediate progress is as follows: two PPP deals were prepared with IFC (radiotherapy centers in Fergana, Khorezm, and Samarkand regions and multi-profile hospital in the Fergana region). Both PPPs drew preparation funds from the PPF funds of the project. The Radio therapy PP reached the tender stage, and evaluation is still ongoing. As for the Fergana Hospital PPP, the PPP Project Concept and the PPP Evaluation Documents have been finalized and submitted to the government in June 2023.

title.narrative: Number of SOEs privatized (more than 50% of shares divested) and number of infrastructure PPPs completed

comment.narrative:
Measures the number of SOEs privatized and PPPs developed under the project (e.g., feasibility study funded under the PPF)- of the aggregate number of 6, the “SOEs privatized” portion must be at least two, to achieve the end target.  There is some progress to the indicator, however it is not feasible to achieve the end target with the current closing date. The intermediate progress is as following: there are two PPP deals being prepared together with IFC (radiotherapy centers in Fergana, Khorezm, and Samarkand regions and Multiprofile hospital in the Fergana region); and pre-privatization processes discussed with SAMA for several companies. 
The Radiotherapy centers PPP is at the Request for proposal stage of procurement. tender stage, with 3 consortiums having met the requirements of the previous qualifications stage. Study to prepare the project concept and the project evaluation document is ongoing for the deal of Fergana multi-profile hospital. Technical and financial advisors are working on structuring the PPP project.
